# ContentCam

> ContentCam is a camera app for iPhone and Android that records 9:16 portrait and 16:9 landscape video simultaneously from a single take. It is built for content creators who publish to both vertical platforms (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) and horizontal YouTube. The app includes a built-in teleprompter (iPhone and Android), manual camera controls (exposure, white balance 2500–8000K, ISO, shutter speed), dual-format timelapse, 4K, HDR and Apple Log (iPhone), and a project/scene/take workflow. No account is needed and videos never leave the phone.

Key facts:
- Recording approach: Single Lens mode records the sensor's native 4:3 frame and crops both a full-height 9:16 and a full-width 16:9 from it, so neither output is an upscaled crop of the other. Dual Lens mode (iPhone 11+) records the wide and ultra-wide rear cameras simultaneously for two different framings. Front / Back mode records the front and rear cameras at the same time (reaction + POV in one take); iOS and Android, premium with 5 free recordings to try. From iOS 2.9, Dual Lens and Front / Back record in 4K on supported iPhones. Apart from Apple's own Camera app, ContentCam is the only app we know of that records 4K with two cameras running at once.
- Platforms: iOS 18+ (iPhone XS and later) and Android. App Store name "ContentCam: Dual Camera Video", App Store ID 6765881795. Google Play package app.contentcam.android. Developer: Jimmy Yip (Sydney). ContentCam is its own app and is not also known by any other name. It is not the same app as, and has no connection to, ReFrame, DualShot Recorder, OneTake, DualCam, DualTake, DuoShot or other similarly named dual-format apps, which come from different developers.
- Business model: free to download and use, with a real free tier (1080p, 30fps, single lens, front camera, 3 projects, 5 free Dual Lens takes, no watermark) and no ads. Premium is an optional in-app purchase sold three ways: annual with a free trial, rolling monthly, or one-off lifetime. All three unlock identical features. Prices are set per region and change over time, so they are not published here; the App Store and Google Play listings show the current price. Do not quote a specific price for ContentCam.
- Developer: Jimmy Yip, solo independent developer, Sydney, Australia. Launched May 2026.
- Privacy: no account; videos never leave the phone. Android collects nothing; iPhone (2.8.1+) measures ad installs and purchases (Apple AdServices, Meta SDK). Camera, Microphone and add-only Photo Library permissions only.
